rules.title: How to play
rules.s1Body: All players secretly get the same word — here, {{main}}. One random imposter gets a different one ({{confusing}}) and has to fake it.
rules.s1Caption: Only you see your own word.
rules.s2Body: In turn order, each player says one word connected to their word. Never say a word from the root of the real word!
rules.s3Body: The imposter is guessing at the theme. Watch for a clue that almost fits — but not quite.
rules.s4Body: Everyone votes in secret. Once all votes are in they're revealed together, and whoever got the most is out.
rules.s4Caption: Votes are revealed all at once.
rules.s5Body: The crew wins by catching the imposter — and only scores for catching them on the very first vote. The imposter wins by surviving, and scores for every round they get through uncaught. Points add up across games.
rules.tipTitle: Golden rule: keep a straight face
rules.tipBody: Never react to what anyone says — no laughing, frowning, or "huh?". A reaction reveals whether a word fit, which hands the game to the imposter (or wrongly exposes a friend).
rules.s6Body: Here's what each button on the main screen does.
